name: gscdump
description: gscdump syncs Google Search Console data, backfills up to 16 months of available history, and preserves your collected data for MCP, API, and SQL.
suggestedPrompts: Which of my Sites lost the most clicks this week?
Which queries sit at positions 4 to 20 with high impressions?
Is my home page indexed by Google? Show the verdict and the date.
